qa_pairs.question: What component is indicated by the designation S326 in the diagram?
How many rear side marker lights are shown in the circuit diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: Four rear side marker lights - LH rear side marker light and RH rear side marker light on each side

qa_pairs.question: What type of switch controls the trunk light according to the diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: Trunk light switch that is closed with trunk open
